item.title: Nicole Kidman Opens Up About Divorces From Tom Cruise, Keith Urban: ‘It’s All New … Every Time’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show, where we dive into the latest news and trends. Today, we're talking about Nicole Kidman, who's opening up about her high-profile divorces from Tom Cruise and Keith Urban.
[Soft music continues in the background]
Host: In a recent interview with British Vogue, Kidman shared some rare insights into her personal life. When asked to compare her two divorces, she said, "It's all new... every time!" She emphasized that her focus is on her children, saying, "Family comes first. It's an extraordinary purpose. Everything else is not important."
[Short pause]
Host: Kidman shares two daughters with Urban, Sunday Rose and Faith Margaret, and two children from her marriage to Cruise, Bella and Connor. She admitted that this year has been tough, but her priorities remain clear: putting her kids first and being there for them.
[Soft music swells]
Host: Kidman also reflected on her past, including her marriage to Tom Cruise, which she described as a whirlwind romance. She said, "We just fell madly in love, and it was that simple." As for her recent split from Keith Urban, she was more guarded, but acknowledged a sense of uncertainty and hope for the future.
[Short pause]
Host: When asked to sum up how she's feeling now, Kidman used phrases like "free falling" and "jumping off," suggesting a sense of transition and exploration. But one thing is certain: she'll be returning to the screen in the upcoming sequel Practical Magic 2, reuniting with co-star Sandra Bullock.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for joining us, and we'll catch you in the next episode!
